dwc.title: Dugladze - Diversity of georgian character
heads: From the lush valleys to the highland vineyards, Georgia’s wine regions showcase a captivating variety, making it a treasure trove for wine lovers and connoisseurs alike.
Diversity defines the wine regions of Georgia, each offering its own unique character shaped by distinct soils, climates, and traditions.

Georgia is celebrated as the "Cradle of Wine," a land with over 8,000 years of winemaking heritage. Here, the art of viticulture began as early as the Neolithic period, with wine crafted in ancient pre-Qvevri vessels—a tradition that has endured and evolved through millennia.

At the heart of Georgian winemaking lies the Kakheti region, renowned for its rich heritage and exceptional wines. It proudly holds the largest number of Protected Designations of Origin (PDOs), reflecting its commitment to quality and authenticity.
Home to 525 indigenous grape varieties—nearly one-sixth of the world’s total—Georgia offers an unparalleled diversity of flavors and wine styles.
Even the word "wine" itself reflects Georgia's influence. Linguists trace its origin in European languages—vinum, vin, wine, wein, вино—back to the Georgian word “ghvino.”

In 2013, UNESCO recognized Georgia's unique Qvevri winemaking method by inscribing it onto the Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity. This ancient technique, using large clay vessels buried underground, produces wines that embody Georgia’s rich history and deep connection to the land.
Experience the essence of Georgia, where every vineyard tells a story, and every glass is a journey through time.

heads: A Family Legacy of Heritage, Innovation, and Excellence

Our story began in the 1980s, when Dimitri Dugladze transformed a lifelong devotion to wine and spirits into a family winery that would become a legacy of passion, vision, and craftsmanship. Rooted in Georgia’s ancient winemaking traditions and elevated by the precision of modern techniques, Dugladze Wine Company has grown into a symbol of authenticity and refinement.

Today, the second and third generation of the Dugladze family continues this journey, carrying forward the founder’s spirit while bringing the winery to the highest international standards. Each bottle tells a story — a dialogue between heritage and innovation, celebrating timeless elegance and the soulful essence of Georgia’s vineyards.

One of the most defining chapters in our history unfolded during the era of Dimitri Dugladze. At a time when the Soviet Union was collapsing, and Georgia was reclaiming its place on the global stage, Dimitri played a pivotal role in ensuring that Georgia’s 8,000-year-old winemaking heritage was recognized worldwide. His vision, dedication, and expertise propelled the company forward, establishing Dugladze as a symbol of Georgian craftsmanship

Today, the second and third generation of the Dugladze family continues this remarkable journey, driven by the same passion and vision. We are not just winemakers—we are ambassadors of Georgian wine, sharing the exquisite quality of our wines and spirits with the world. With a commitment to innovation, sustainability, and authenticity, Dugladze Wine Company remains at the forefront of Georgia’s winemaking legacy, expanding our reach across international markets while staying true to the traditions that define us. Guided by the expertise of our esteemed chief winemaker, Temur Gonjilashvili, the Dugladze family remains committed to crafting wines that reflect the soul of Georgia. With vineyards spanning three distinct regions and state-of-the-art facilities, we celebrate the diverse terroirs and traditions that make Georgian wines truly unique.
From our vineyards to your glass, every bottle tells a story—a story of heritage, craftsmanship, and the timeless beauty of Georgian wine.

Dugladze Wine Company takes pride in preserving and innovating the ancient Kakhetian winemaking method. Our Qvevri wines—fermented in large earthenware vessels buried underground—capture the essence of Georgia’s rich heritage. This meticulous, UNESCO-recognized process blends history with craftsmanship to create wines with unparalleled character and depth.

Nestled in the heart of Georgia's Gurjaani wine region, the Dugladze winery offers an immersive experience for wine lovers. Here, surrounded by breathtaking landscapes, visitors can explore the art of winemaking and taste the diverse flavors of Dugladze wines.

heads: VITICULTURE AND WINEMAKING: CRAFTING WINES WITH PASSION AND PRECISION

At Dugladze Wine Company, every bottle we produce is a result of meticulous care and time-honored traditions, seamlessly blended with modern techniques. Our viticulture and winemaking processes are driven by a deep respect for the land and the vine, ensuring that each wine reflects the true essence of Georgia’s diverse terroirs.

Harvest is an intricate and personal process, conducted manually to ensure the perfect balance of acidity and ripeness. Each vineyard is carefully harvested parcel by parcel, row by row, after a series of seven maturity tests. This allows us to select the grapes at their peak, contributing to a richer aromatic profile and exceptional quality, all while honoring the vine’s natural rhythms.

Throughout the vinification process, we focus on preserving the unique characteristics of each grape variety. We carefully nurture the inherent fruit flavors and tannins, allowing the true identity of each wine to emerge. Our winemaking team’s expertise ensures that every step, from fermentation to maturation, enhances the natural qualities of the grapes.
MATURATION AND BOTTLING: ENHANCING FLAVOR AND QUALITY

Our wines undergo a careful maturation process that combines advanced techniques like micro-oxygenation, designed to enhance the fruit flavors of our whites and minimize astringency in our reds. We employ a variety of methods, such as cooling, inter-pressing, gentle pumping, and barrel fermentation, all to ensure the highest quality. Bottling is a precise process, supported by rigorous quality control measures. Constant sampling and analysis in our state-of-the-art in-house laboratory ensure consistency and excellence from the first bottle to the last.

With over 500 hectares of vineyards spread across Georgia’s finest winemaking regions, Dugladze Wine Company is committed to sustainability and innovation. Our vineyards are nurtured with care, and we work closely with local farmers and winemakers, ensuring a continued partnership to support and elevate Georgian winemaking. Our annual production of 20 million bottles is a testament to our dedication to excellence and growth. At Dugladze, we don’t just make wine; we craft a journey from vine to bottle, bringing the best of Georgia’s land and heritage to every glass.

In our cellars, we house a range of French and American oak barrels, selected for their diverse terroirs and toasting levels. The aging process is tailored to each wine, allowing the oak to enhance the wine's complexity and balance. This careful attention to detail ensures that each wine reaches its full potential, beautifully reflecting the unique qualities of its terroir.

heads: At Dugladze Winery, we have transformed Georgia’s 8,000-year-old winemaking tradition into a globally recognized success story. Through dedication, innovation, and a passion for excellence, we have expanded far beyond our homeland—bringing the authentic flavors of Georgian wine to consumers worldwide.
A CENTURY-LONG JOURNEY TO GLOBAL SUCCESS

Dimitri Dugladze founded the first spirits-producing factory in the Caucasus. From these humble beginnings, Dugladze Winery has grown into one of the most respected Georgian wine brands internationally. The journey was both exciting and challenging, requiring a deep commitment to quality, the modernization of production techniques, and the ability to navigate complex international markets. Today, Dugladze Winery proudly stands as a global ambassador of Georgian wine, combining traditional winemaking expertise with a forward-thinking approach to international growth.

Dugladze wines are now exported to over 30 countries, with a rapidly growing presence in key markets across Europe, North America, and Asia. We work with a diverse network of trusted distributors, retailers, and partners in these regions, ensuring that Georgian wine is accessible to both seasoned wine lovers and new consumers.

Dugladze Winery is committed to maintaining the highest standards of quality while continuously expanding our global presence. We have built long-term relationships with importers, wine shops, restaurants, and hospitality partners across multiple continents, ensuring that Georgian wine is represented in some of the most competitive and prestigious markets. With 500 hectares of vineyards in Georgia’s premier wine-growing regions and an annual production of about 20 million bottles, we are uniquely positioned to meet the rising global demand for authentic, high-quality Georgian wines.

Beyond simply exporting wine, Dugladze Winery plays a key role in promoting Georgia’s winemaking heritage to a worldwide audience. Our participation in international wine exhibitions, competitions, and collaborations with top sommeliers and wine experts helps educate and engage consumers in different markets. With a vision for continued growth and innovation, Dugladze Winery remains at the forefront of the global wine industry—bringing the taste of Georgia to wine lovers from North America to Europe, from Turkey to Asia, and beyond.
